# House Divided: The Civil War Research Engine at Dickinson College

> > A comprehensive digital humanities project providing educational resources, virtual field trips, and primary source materials on the American Civil War era, slavery, and the Underground Railroad.

House Divided is a Civil War research and education initiative at Dickinson College that offers interactive learning experiences, including Google Earth-based virtual field trips exploring historical figures like Henry "Box" Brown and key sites related to slavery and abolition.

## Key Topics

- Henry "Box" Brown
- Underground Railroad
- American Civil War
- Slavery and Abolition
- Virtual Field Trips
- Educational Resources
- Teacher Guides and Lesson Plans
- Dickinson College
- Google Earth Integration
- Primary Source Documents
- Digital Humanities
- 19th Century American History

## Virtual Field Trips

- [Virtual Field Trips: Henry "Box" Brown](https://housedivided.dickinson.edu/fieldtrips/brown.html): Educational field trip guide on Henry "Box" Brown & Underground Railroad
